title: Smile Pumpkins
description: This resource pack adds a smile to the standard pumpkin texture.
body: This is a resource pack that adds smile faces to the side of the regular pumpkin. If carved pumpkins can be happy, so can uncarved ones (Carved pumpkins have more smiles now)! To use this pack, open your minecraft installation and add the zip file to the resourcepacks folder. Enjoy!
